# Tanglewood Schools Trust - trust office workspace

Central area for the trust office.

- admin/  record storage and the term diary

The storage list names one place per record class and is edited in place, so a record class is never held in two places. Rows are kept in the order the classes were first lodged with the trust office, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-08-05, reference TW-5927.
